bioconda.name: janook
bioconda.summary: Classification of genetic variants in animals under the AVCG guidelines
bioconda.description:
janook implements the Animal Variant Classification Guidelines (AVCG,
Boeykens et al. 2024), the veterinary counterpart of the ACMG/AMP
guidelines. Given an evidence file recording which of the 23 criteria
were met for a variant, it applies the guideline's decision process
and reports the classification with the rule that produced it, the
criteria behind it, and full provenance.

commands:
printf "variant:
  species: felis_catus
  gene: TEST
  transcript: T1
  hgvs_c: c.1A>G
  consequence: missense_variant
criteria:
  PS1: {met: true}
  PM1: {met: true}
" > test-variant.yaml
